functional_changes: Frozen EXE resource lookup no longer uses _MEIPASS; config is resolved beside the EXE, with parent-level fallback for ClubAudioAnalyzer\dist\ClubAudioAnalyzer.exe + ClubAudioAnalyzer\config.
PyInstaller build no longer embeds config into the one-file executable.
build_windows.bat copies config and ffmpeg beside the EXE under dist and removes unused _MEI folders after build.
cleanup_after_build.bat removes TEMP _MEI folders and all project folders except dist, config, ffmpeg; dist keeps config, ffmpeg and root files such as the EXE.

Analysis result now contains Pre % and Post % columns; Post % is computed by applying every proposed Bell EQ as a digital biquad frequency response to the measured FFT spectrum, then recomputing active-band energy occupancy.
Post % is normalized across the same 10 active bands as Pre %.
Existing analysis, reference generation, band customization, band save/apply/default, JSON drag-and-drop, MP3/WAV/AIFF analysis and navigation behavior remain covered by tests.
gui_verification: Initial screen: reference-data controls retained; no return-home button; 40px internal padding; 110% font scale relative to v29 baseline.

Band customization: decision button right-aligned with 40px right margin; save/apply/default controls remain right-center and 40px above their previous positions; input boxes black fill, white border, yellow text.
Result screen: Band / Pre % / Post % / EQ / Diff / Sample / Target columns; Status and Priority absent.
native_windows_limit: PySide6 and PyInstaller are not installed in this Linux verification environment, so native Windows EXE launch/build could not be executed here. Source/static checks, analysis-function tests, GUI geometry assertions, JSON/runtime-resource checks, and compilation were executed.
